βέλτερόν: βέλτερος — better; comparative of ἀγαθός, epic (= Attic βελτίων); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’it is better’
γνώσεται: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; fut. 3 sg. (middle in form): ’will come to know’
δατέονται: δατέομαι — divide, share out; pres. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic δατοῦνται): ’share out’
δαῖε: δαίω — kindle, set alight; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔδαιε): ’kindled’
δρόμου: δρόμος — running, a run, course; masc. gen. sg., genitive of what one is sated with: ’with running’
δόρποιο: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), object of μέδεσθαι
εἰρύσσονται: εἴρυμαι (ἐρύομαι) — guard, protect; pres. 3 pl. mid., epic doubled σ (= Attic ῥύονται), with future sense: ’will guard’
εἴσιδε: εἰσεῖδον (used as aor. of εἰσοράω) — catch sight of; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἰσεῖδε): ’caught sight of’
εἶσ: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg., elided (εἶσ’ = εἶσι), with future sense: ’will go’
καταδημοβορῆσαι: καταδημοβορέω — eat up in common among the people (κατά + δῆμος + βορά); aor. inf. act., rare compound: ’to devour publicly’
κεκόρησθε: κορέννυμι — sate, satisfy; perf. 2 pl. mid./pass., epic κεκόρημαι (= Attic κεκόρεσμαι): ’you have had your fill’
κηδόμενοί: κήδομαι — be anxious, grieve, care; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., accented before enclitic περ: ’worried, troubled’
κιχήσεται: κιχάνω — come upon, find, overtake; fut. 3 sg. mid. (or short-vowel aor. subj.): ’will find, finds’
κρίνονται: κρίνω — separate, decide; mid./pass. fight it out, contend; pres. 3 pl.: ’are decided, fight it out’
κτανέοντα: κτείνω — kill; fut. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic κτανέω- (= Attic κτενοῦντα): ’one who is about to kill’
κυδοιμόν: κυδοιμός — uproar, din of battle; masc. acc. sg.
κυκήθησαν: κυκάω — stir up, throw into confusion; aor. 3 pl. pass.: ’were thrown into confusion’
λαοῖσι: λαός — people, host; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
λεχέεσσι: λέχος — bed, couch, bier; neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic λέχεσι)
μέδεσθαι: μέδομαι — be mindful of, think of, attend to (+ gen.); pres. inf. mid.
μέροπες: μέροψ — epithet of men, ’speech-dividing’ or ’mortal’ (sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl., used adjectivally with ἄνθρωποι
μίσγετο: μίγνυμι (epic μίσγω) — mix; mid. mingle with, join; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐμίγνυτο): ’mingled, joined’
μακραὶ: μακρός — long, tall; fem. nom. pl.
μυθέσκοντο: μυθέομαι — speak, say, call; impf. 3 pl. mid., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’used to call’
μυρόμενοι: μύρομαι — weep, lament; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’lamenting’
μῃονίην: Μῃονίη — Maeonia (Lydia); fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic Μῃονία)
νηυσίν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν) (= Attic ναυσί)
ξυνὸς: ξυνός — common, shared (= Attic κοινός); masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’common to all’
πέμψεν: πέμπω — send; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, with ν-movable (= ἔπεμψε): ’sent’
πίθεσθέ: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; aor. 2 imper. mid. 2 pl., accented before enclitic μοι: ’obey’
παντοίου: παντοῖος — of every kind; masc. gen. sg.: ’of every sort’
περικτιόνεσσιν: περικτίων — dweller around, neighbour (περί + κτίζω); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -σι)
περιπλομένων: περιπέλομαι — come round, revolve, circle about; aor. part. mid. gen. pl.: ’circling round’ (of years, of besieging foes)
περνάμεν: πέρνημι — sell (Attic πιπράσκω); pres. part. mid./pass. neut. nom. pl., elided περνάμεν’ (= περνάμενα): ’being sold’
πιθώμεθα: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, be persuaded, + dat.; aor. 2 subj. mid. 1 pl., in a condition: ’we obey, we are persuaded’
πολύχρυσον: πολύχρυσος — rich in gold; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg., agreeing with πόλιν
πτόλιός: πτόλις (epic by-form of πόλις) — city; fem. gen. sg., epic -ιος (= Attic πόλεως), accented before enclitic τε
πυρσοί: πυρσός — beacon, signal-fire; masc. nom. pl.
στήσομαι: ἵστημι — set, stand; mid. take one’s stand; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall take my stand’
στησόμεθ: ἵστημι — set, stand; mid. take one’s stand; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (στησόμεθ’ = στησόμεθα): ’we shall take our stand’
συλλέξας: συλλέγω — gather, collect; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gathered’
σφετέρου: σφέτερος — their own (possessive of σφεῖς); neut. gen. sg.: ’their own’
σφοῖς: σφός — their own, his own; epic possessive adj. (= Attic σφέτερος); masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’their own’
τείχεός: τεῖχος — wall; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -εος (= Attic τείχους), accented before an enclitic
τρόπεον: τροπέω (epic by-form of τρέπω) — turn, wheel round; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, uncontracted (= Attic ἐτρόπουν): ’turned’
φέρτρῳ: φέρτρον — bier, litter; neut. dat. sg.
φέρῃσι: φέρω — bear, carry off, win; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσι (= Attic φέρῃ), with κε: ’may carry off’
φαῖν: φαίνω — show, make appear; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., elided (φαῖν’ = φαῖνε): ’show, display’
φεύξομαι: φεύγω — flee, flee from (+ acc.); fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall flee’
φθέγξατ: φθέγγομαι — utter a sound, call out; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (φθέγξατ’ = φθέγξατο): ’raised her voice’
φλεγέθουσιν: φλεγέθω — blaze, burn (poetic by-form of φλέγω); pres. 3 pl. act.: ’blaze’
φράζεσθε: φράζομαι — consider, take thought, take heed; pres. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’consider’
φύγῃ: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., with κε: ’may flee, may escape’
χαίρεσκον: χαίρω — rejoice; impf. 1 sg., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’I used to rejoice’
χωρήσαντες: χωρέω — give way, draw back, withdraw; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having drawn back’
ἀΐσσουσα: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, shoot; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’darting’
ἀλκτῆρες: ἀλκτήρ — warder-off, defence (+ gen. of the harm); masc. nom. pl.: ’warders-off’
ἀμβροσίη: ἀμβρόσιος — ambrosial, divine, immortal; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic -ία)
ἀμφιμάχωνται: ἀμφιμάχομαι — fight around; pres. subj. 3 pl. mid., in a general relative clause without ἄν or κε: ’fight around’
ἀνιάζει: ἀνιάζω — grieve, distress; pres. 3 sg. act., intransitive: ’is distressed, grieves’
ἀπέπαυσε: ἀποπαύω — stop, make cease; aor. 3 sg. act., augment inside the compound: ’stopped’
ἀρέσθ: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain; aor. inf. mid., elided (ἀρέσθ’ = ἀρέσθαι): ’to win’
ἀργοὶ: ἀργός — swift or white (meaning disputed for dogs, both senses possible); masc. nom. pl.
ἀριζήλη: ἀρίζηλος (= Attic ἀρίδηλος) — very clear, conspicuous; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg.
ἀφίξεται: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, come to; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will come’
ἄλγιον: ἀλγεινός — painful; comparative ἀλγίων, neut. ἄλγιον, epic (= Attic ἀλγεινότερον); neut. nom. sg.: ’more painful’
ἄρεω: ἀρή (gen. ἄρεω, as if from ἄρης) — bane, ruin; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic ἀρῆς): ’of ruin’ · also Ἄρης — Ares, war; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic Ἄρεως): ’of war’
ἄστυδε: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg. with -δε suffix: ’to the town’
ἄσῃ: ἄω — satiate, sate (+ acc. of person, gen. of what); aor. subj. 3 sg. act.: ’has sated’
ἐάσει: ἐάω — allow, permit, let be; fut. 3 sg.: ’will allow’
ἐΰξεστοι: ἐΰξεστος — well-polished, well-planed (εὖ + ξέω); adj. of two endings, nom. pl.
ἐζευγμέναι: ζεύγνυμι — yoke, join; perf. part. mid./pass. fem. nom. pl.: ’joined, bound together’
ἐκπέρσει: ἐκπέρθω — sack, destroy utterly; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will sack’
ἐλπόμενος: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’hoping’
ἐξαπόλωλε: ἐξαπόλλυμι — destroy utterly; perf. 3 sg., intransitive: ’has perished, has vanished’
ἐξεφάνη: ἐκφαίνω — show forth; aor. 3 sg. pass., intransitive: ’appeared, came into view’
ἐπέπαυτ: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); plpf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπέπαυτ’ = ἐπέπαυτο): ’had ceased’
ἐπήτριμοι: ἐπήτριμος — close-set, crowded, thick; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. pl.
ἐπαυρέμεν: ἐπαυρίσκω — get a share of, enjoy (+ gen. or acc.); aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπαυρεῖν): ’to have the benefit of’
ἐρύσαντες: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having dragged, having hauled’
ἐφετμήν: ἐφετμή — command, charge; fem. acc. sg.
ἐφορμηθῆναι: ἐφορμάω — set in motion against; pass. rush upon, charge; aor. inf. pass.: ’to rush on’
ἑσταότων: ἵστημι — stand; perf. part. masc. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἑστώτων): ’standing’
ἔκπληγεν: ἐκπλήσσω — strike senseless, astound; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic ἔκπληγεν (= Attic ἐξεπλάγησαν): ’were astounded’
ἔλυσαν: λύω — loose, untie, unyoke, cast off; aor. 3 pl. act.
ἔστεφε: στέφω — put around, crown; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’crowned’
ἕζεσθαι: ἕζομαι — sit, seat oneself; pres. inf. mid.
ἕξομεν: ἔχω — have, hold; fut. 1 pl.: ’we shall have’
ἠλασκάζων: ἠλασκάζω — wander about, roam; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’roaming’
ἤϋσ: ἀΰω — shout, call aloud; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἤϋσ’ = ἤϋσε): ’shouted’
ἰαύων: ἰαύω — sleep, lie down to rest; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’sleeping’
ἰφθίμοισι: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ὀρθῶν: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. gen. pl.: ’upright’
ὁρμηθεὶς: ὁρμάω — set in motion, urge on; pass. set out, be impelled; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having set out’
ὄσσοντο: ὄσσομαι — see in the mind, foresee, forebode; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’foresaw, foreboded’
ὑπέρβιος: ὑπέρβιος — exceeding, excessive, of violent strength (ὑπέρ + βία); adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg.: ’exceeding’
ὑψηλαί: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. nom. pl.
ὠδύσατο: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry, take offence; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’grew angry’
ὠπίζετ: ὀπίζομαι — respect, have regard for, fear; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ὠπίζετ’ = ὠπίζετο): ’respected’
ῥηΐτεροι: ῥηΐτερος — easier, more easily done (epic comparative of ῥηΐδιος, = Attic ῥᾴων); masc. nom. pl.: ’easier’

__broaden__.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’ · also intensive gen. sg. after a possessive, of the speaker: ’of myself’ (ἐμὸν αὐτοῦ ’my own’) · also intensive gen. sg. after a possessive, of a third person: ’his own’ (ἑῷ αὐτοῦ θυμῷ ’his own heart’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it’, ’upon it’ (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ ’upon it’) · also gen. sg. standing for a thing, partitive after τὸ μέν: ’of it’ (τὸ μὲν αὐτοῦ ’one part of it’) · also gen. sg. standing apart from its noun: ’his’ (διὰ δ’ αὐτοῦ … ὀδόντων ’through his teeth’) · also gen. sg., object of ἀπήμβροτε: ’him’ (αὐτοῦ ἀπήμβροτε ’missed him’) · also gen. sg. standing for a neuter thing: ’from it’ (ἐκ … αὐτοῦ ’from it’)
__broaden__.τῇς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic τῇς (= Attic ταῖς): relative ’to whom’ · also demonstrative, ’to them’ (of gates, ἐπὶ τῇς ἀραρυῖαι ’fitted to them’)
__broaden__.χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’of bronze’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’of bronze’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕπνον: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον ὕπνον ’a bronze sleep’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὐρανόν: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον οὐρανόν ’the bronze heaven’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄπα: ’bronze’ (ὄπα χάλκεον ’bronze voice’)
__broaden__.γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive after δῖα: ’the divine one among women’ · also fem. gen. pl., dependent on χερσί: ’of the women’ · also fem. gen. pl. after πρό: ’in defence of the wives’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’in front of, for their wives’) · also fem. gen. pl., dependent on φῦλα: ’tribes of women’ · also fem. gen. pl., in apposition to ἀνθρώπων with ἀνδρῶν: ’of women’ · also fem. gen. pl., with ἤτε … ἤτε, dependent on θέμις: ’of men or of women’ (θέμις … ἀνδρῶν ἤτε γυναικῶν) · also fem. gen. pl. after περί: ’for the women’ (περὶ … γυναικῶν)
__broaden__.ναῦφιν: ναῦς — ship; pl. with epic suffix -φιν, ablatival (’from the ships’; = Attic νεῶν) · also with παρά, locatival: ’beside the ships’ (παρὰ ναῦφιν)
__broaden__.πολύχαλκον: πολύχαλκος — of much bronze, rich in bronze (epithet of the sky); masc. acc. sg. · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with πόλιν: ’rich in bronze’
